source: Approved restaurant and private-cabin image direction; dimensions proposed for measured Blender fitting, not measured from generated images.

restaurant.note: v3 (user, 2026-10-12): four larger dining bays (bay pitch 2.46 m), one panoramic bay of 2.16 m glass per dining bay centred on its tables, 0.30 m piers behind the meeting banquette backs, a fifth bay over a 2.8 m bar lounge.

coaches.frame: metres; x along the coach (end A -X, end B +X), y across (+Y compartment/galley side), z up from the top of the rail; Unreal through atelier.conventions.to_unreal only
validated_by_blockout: continuous passage gangway to gangway for a 1.75 m adult (r 0.28) and Cairo (r 0.22)
every room and exterior door reachable

length over buffers 24.0 m and coupling distance

notes: The earlier 2.05 m cabin-width concept target is adjusted to 2.00 m for this coherent draft envelope.
Counts and lengths are preliminary; Claude must reconcile exterior window spacing, vestibules and service areas in the measured floor plan.
Raster images convey appearance only. Scale and dimensional compliance must be checked on actual meshes in Blender.
Do not stretch or compress furniture independently by axis to force a fit; revise the mesh or the agreed target dimensions and report changes.
These records are planning targets, not an existing 3D model or Tripo credit spend.

Wall sconces counted: 10 in the restaurant piers + 4 per cabin on the bulkheads = 26.
No furniture dimension changed: every object fits its reservation with knee gaps of 0.10 m (restaurant) and 0.385 m (cabin sofa front to table).

Envelope widened at the user's request for roomy luxury corridors: exterior 3.10 -> 3.60 m (interior 3.45), first-class corridor 0.90 -> 1.20 m, cabins 2.00 -> 2.20 m, restaurant aisle 0.98 -> 1.48 m. Heights, coupling and gauge unchanged.
